Diagnosis of Malnutrition
Malnutrition is defined as a suboptimal or deficient supply of nutrients that interferes with an 
individual’s growth, development, general health, or recovery from illness. A BMI of less than 
18.5 kg/m2 defines adults who are consistently underweight and at risk for malnutrition. Infants
